summary:
可口可樂EPS超預期5.9%，營收年增12%顯示定價策略與品牌韌性帶動穩健成長。
• EPS 0.86美元，超出預期0.81美元，超預期幅度5.88%
• 營收124.7億美元，年增12.07%，定價與全球品牌力支撑成長
• 輕資產裝瓶模式提供高利潤率與穩定現金流
• 必需消費屬性與高股息為防禦型配置首選
ai_view:
訊號穩健：EPS超預期近6%搭配12%營收年增，顯示可口可樂定價策略奏效、全球品牌韌性強，獲利防禦性佳。短期股價有支撑，25倍本益比反映防禦溢價。中期觀察價格貢獻退場後銷量能否接棒、以及無糖與新興品類成長。追蹤指標：有機營收價/量拆分、各區域銷量、匯率影響、營業利潤率與股息成長。

需留意：定價貢獻在高基期後恐遞減，銷量增長成關鍵；匯率（美元走強）對海外營收換算造成壓力；健康意識上升對含糖飲料的長期結構性逆風

summary_en:
Coca-Cola beat EPS by 5.9% with 12% revenue growth, as pricing strategy and brand resilience drive steady gains.
• EPS of $0.86 beat the $0.81 estimate by 5.88%
• Revenue of $12.47B grew 12.07%, with pricing and global brand power supporting growth
• An asset-light bottling model delivers high margins and stable cash flow
• Staples nature and a high dividend make it a top defensive allocation

ai_view_en:
Signal is steady: a ~6% EPS beat with 12% revenue growth shows Coca-Cola's pricing strategy working and strong global brand resilience, with good earnings defensiveness. Near-term the stock has support, with a 25x P/E reflecting a defensive premium. Mid-term, watch whether volume takes over as pricing fades, plus zero-sugar and new-category growth. Track: price/volume split in organic revenue, regional volumes, FX impact, operating margin and dividend growth.

Watch：Pricing contribution may fade off a high base, making volume growth key; FX (a stronger dollar) pressures translation of overseas revenue; Rising health awareness is a long-term structural headwind for sugary drinks
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期5.88%，營收年增12.07%反映定價與量價組合佳。
